levels.surface: أبي أبى ابن امرأة، عبادة بن الصامت

notes: Two taḥwīl branches carrying the same saying, each writing its own names.
The editor's gloss «- المعنى -» is left out.

«ابن أخت» and «ابن امرأة» are epithets of the nephew; each is kept with the name written after it, as one link (rule 7 comma form). This is the least certain part of the reading: the text does not say whether the epithet is a separate man.
